read_only_findings: Both spell and pending direct entry copy CardComponent without reading FaceDownComponent, exposing the face-up underlying characteristics as the new copy.
CreateTokenExecutor installs creation-time static/triggered/activated abilities through components and GameState grants. CardComponent-only entry copying loses those intrinsic abilities.
Permanent duration does not establish copiable provenance: later granted abilities must remain excluded.
Copy-of-copy must retain its own intrinsic payload after original token departure; leaving the battlefield must remove copied ability grants and restore printed identity.
planned_design_requirements: Pure serializable copiable characteristic/ability provenance; never mutate global CardRegistry to register runtime tokens.
Share capture between cast and pending direct entry; sanitize face-down copiable values before copying or revealing them.
Retain all original copy-exception carrier and seven copied-choice assertions. These new entry-copy dependencies require their regression bank; do not repeat a standalone carrier qualification.
Preserve ordinary granted-ability behavior and serialization defaults; classify compatibility for older saved tokens without guessing provenance.
scope: Eight negative cast/direct and serialization cases plus two existing passing controls. Token tests also check counters/tap/grants exclusion, actual triggered/activated/static behavior, copy-of-copy after real departure, and exit cleanup. X control checks symbol/field semantics only, not chosen-X payment.

Inspecting physical grant deletion immediately after a low-level departure would reject valid event handling. The revised fixture performs a real recast and declines copying before the unchanged three cleanup assertions, also requiring no stale ETB trigger and original0/5 characteristics.
